description: Receive WhatsApp messages, media included, from chosen chats of the numbers this deployment connects.

serviceForm.label: Whapi API URL
serviceForm.help: The Whapi gateway every number talks to; empty means the default.

serviceForm.label: Numbers
serviceForm.help: One item per Whapi channel. Every Organization can pick any number for its Projects.

item.label: Channel ID
item.help: The channel's ID on the Whapi dashboard.

item.label: Label
item.help: The name Projects pick the number by.

item.label: API token
item.help: The channel's API token from the Whapi dashboard.

item.label: Webhook secret
item.help: Generated. Saving registers it with Whapi as the `X-Opsiforce-Webhook-Secret` header of this deployment's webhook; Rotate registers a new one.

projectForm.label: Numbers
projectForm.help: The numbers this environment receives from, each with the chats it listens to.

item.label: Chats
item.help: Individual chats and groups whose messages this environment receives.

message.received.title: Message received
message.received.description: A WhatsApp message arrived in one of the chats this environment listens to, media as the Event's file; its data is described in the Service skill.
